```{r setup}
#| include: false
source("../R/utils.R")
source("../R/forecast_chlorophyll.R")
source("../R/forecast_covariates.R")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(purrr)

cfg <- load_config("../config.yml")
bloom_threshold <- 5

clean_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
       plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 26),
       legend.title = element_blank())

# rough severity tier for a bloom's current level
bloom_severity <- function(val) {
  if (val > 20) "severe"
  else if (val > 10) "moderate"
  else "mild"
}

latest_forecast_for <- function(cfg, buoy_id) {
  keys <- aws.s3::get_bucket_df(
    bucket = cfg$s3$bucket, prefix = paste0(cfg$s3$write_path, "/", buoy_id, "-"),
    base_url = cfg$s3$base_url, use_https = TRUE, region = "",
    key = Sys.getenv("OSN_KEY"), secret = Sys.getenv("OSN_SECRET"), max = Inf
  )$Key
  if (length(keys) == 0) return(NULL)
  ref_dates <- as.Date(sub(paste0(buoy_id, "-(.*)-forecast\\.csv"), "\\1", basename(keys)))
  fc <- read_s3_csv(cfg, cfg$s3$write_path, basename(keys[which.max(ref_dates)]))
  fc$ref_date <- max(ref_dates)
  fc
}

# Empirical quantiles of (forecast - observed) by lead time, for a non-parametric prediction interval
compute_live_lead_quantiles <- function(cfg, buoy_id, data, bloom_threshold, window_days = 90,
                                        probs = c(0.1, 0.9)) {
  keys <- aws.s3::get_bucket_df(
    bucket = cfg$s3$bucket, prefix = paste0(cfg$s3$write_path, "/", buoy_id, "-"),
    base_url = cfg$s3$base_url, use_https = TRUE, region = "",
    key = Sys.getenv("OSN_KEY"), secret = Sys.getenv("OSN_SECRET"), max = Inf
  )$Key
  if (length(keys) == 0) return(NULL)
  ref_dates <- as.Date(sub(paste0(buoy_id, "-(.*)-forecast\\.csv"), "\\1", basename(keys)))
  live <- ref_dates > as.Date("2024-12-31") & ref_dates >= Sys.Date() - window_days
  keys <- keys[live]
  ref_dates <- ref_dates[live]
  if (length(keys) == 0) return(NULL)

  scored <- purrr::map2_dfr(keys, ref_dates, function(key, ref_date) {
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
    aws.s3::save_object(object = key, bucket = cfg$s3$bucket, file = tmp,
                        base_url = cfg$s3$base_url, use_https = TRUE, region = "",
                        key = Sys.getenv("OSN_KEY"), secret = Sys.getenv("OSN_SECRET"))
    d <- readr::read_csv(tmp, show_col_types = FALSE)
    unlink(tmp)
    d$ref_date <- ref_date
    d
  })
  if (nrow(scored) == 0) return(NULL)

  ref_branch <- data %>%
    transmute(ref_date = date, branch = ifelse(!is.na(chlorophyll) & chlorophyll > bloom_threshold, "Bloom", "Calm"))

  scored <- scored %>%
    mutate(lead_time = as.integer(date - ref_date)) %>%
    left_join(data %>% select(date, observed = chlorophyll), by = "date") %>%
    left_join(ref_branch, by = "ref_date") %>%
    filter(!is.na(observed), !is.na(chlorophyll_forecast))
  if (nrow(scored) == 0) return(NULL)

  scored %>%
    mutate(err = chlorophyll_forecast - observed) %>%
    group_by(branch, lead_time) %>%
    summarise(q_low = quantile(err, probs[1], names = FALSE),
             q_high = quantile(err, probs[2], names = FALSE),
             n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
}

# typical chlorophyll range for this day of year, across all years on record
doy_climatology <- function(data, target_date, window = 5) {
  target_doy <- lubridate::yday(target_date)
  doy_all <- lubridate::yday(data$date)
  doy_dist <- pmin(abs(doy_all - target_doy), 365 - abs(doy_all - target_doy))
  vals <- data$chlorophyll[!is.na(data$chlorophyll) & doy_dist <= window]
  if (length(vals) < 5) return(data.frame(clim_mean = NA, clim_low = NA, clim_high = NA))
  data.frame(clim_mean = mean(vals), clim_low = quantile(vals, 0.1, names = FALSE),
            clim_high = quantile(vals, 0.9, names = FALSE))
}
```

```{r plots}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false
buoy_sections <- lapply(names(cfg$buoys), function(buoy_id) {
  buoy_name <- cfg$buoys[[buoy_id]]$name
  data <- read_s3_csv(cfg, cfg$s3$write_path, paste0(buoy_id, "_training_data.csv"))
  fc <- latest_forecast_for(cfg, buoy_id)
  if (is.null(data) || is.null(fc)) return(NULL)

  csv_filename <- paste0(buoy_id, "_forecast.csv")
  if (!dir.exists("_site")) dir.create("_site", recursive = TRUE)
  readr::write_csv(fc, file.path("_site", csv_filename))

  ref_date <- fc$ref_date[1]
  recent <- data %>% filter(date >= ref_date - 30, date <= ref_date) %>% select(date, chlorophyll)
  today_val <- data$chlorophyll[data$date == ref_date][1]
  branch <- if (!is.na(today_val) && today_val > bloom_threshold) "Bloom" else "Calm"
  branch_color <- if (branch == "Bloom") "#0072B2" else "#56B4E9"
  branch_label <- "Forecast"

  # days since the forecast's seed observation
  days_gap <- as.integer(Sys.Date() - ref_date)
  data_status_html <- paste0("<p class='data-status'>Data current as of <strong>",
                             format(ref_date, "%B %d, %Y"), "</strong></p>")
  gap_warning_html <- if (days_gap > 2) {
    paste0("<p class='data-warning'>Warning: data not received for ", days_gap, " days</p>")
  } else {
    ""
  }

  fc_plot <- bind_rows(data.frame(date = ref_date, chlorophyll_forecast = today_val), fc)
  ts_combined <- bind_rows(
    recent %>% rename(value = chlorophyll) %>% mutate(series = "Observed"),
    fc_plot %>% rename(value = chlorophyll_forecast) %>% mutate(series = branch_label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(hover = paste0(format(date, "%b %d, %Y"), "<br>", series, ": ", round(value, 2), " ug/L"))

  fc_clim <- fc_plot %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(doy_climatology(data, date)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(hover = paste0(format(date, "%b %d"), "<br>Typical range: ", round(clim_low, 1), "-", round(clim_high, 1), " ug/L"))

  # forecast uncertainty band, relative to the 1-day-lead interval
  lead_q <- compute_live_lead_quantiles(cfg, buoy_id, data, bloom_threshold)
  fc_uncertainty <- fc %>% mutate(lead_time = as.integer(date - ref_date))
  branch_q <- if (!is.null(lead_q)) lead_q %>% filter(branch == !!branch) else NULL
  lead1_q <- if (!is.null(branch_q)) branch_q %>% filter(lead_time == 1) else NULL
  if (!is.null(lead_q) && nrow(lead1_q) == 1) {
    fc_uncertainty <- fc_uncertainty %>%
      left_join(branch_q %>% select(lead_time, q_low, q_high, n), by = "lead_time") %>%
      mutate(rel_high = pmax(0, q_high - lead1_q$q_high),
            rel_low = pmin(0, q_low - lead1_q$q_low),
            ymin = pmax(0, chlorophyll_forecast - rel_high), ymax = chlorophyll_forecast - rel_low,
            hover = paste0(format(date, "%b %d"), "<br>+/- ", round(pmax(rel_high, -rel_low), 1),
                          " ug/L beyond 1-day-lead uncertainty (n=", n, ")"))

    if (!is.na(today_val)) {
      day0_row <- data.frame(
        date = ref_date, chlorophyll_forecast = today_val, lead_time = 0L,
        q_low = lead1_q$q_low, q_high = lead1_q$q_high, n = lead1_q$n,
        rel_high = 0, rel_low = 0, ymin = today_val, ymax = today_val,
        hover = paste0(format(ref_date, "%b %d"), "<br>", round(today_val, 1), " ug/L (observed)"))
      fc_uncertainty <- bind_rows(day0_row, fc_uncertainty)
    }
  } else {
    fc_uncertainty <- fc_uncertainty %>% mutate(ymin = NA_real_, ymax = NA_real_, hover = NA_character_)
  }


  ts_combined <- ts_combined %>%
    left_join(fc_clim %>% select(date, clim_low, clim_high), by = "date") %>%
    left_join(fc_uncertainty %>% select(date, ymin, ymax), by = "date") %>%
    mutate(hover = ifelse(series == branch_label & !is.na(clim_low),
                          paste0(hover, "<br>Typical range: ", round(clim_low, 1), "-", round(clim_high, 1), " ug/L"),
                          hover),
          hover = ifelse(series == branch_label & !is.na(ymin),
                          paste0(hover, "<br>80% interval: ", round(ymin, 1), "-", round(ymax, 1), " ug/L"),
                          hover)) %>%
    select(-clim_low, -clim_high, -ymin, -ymax)

  # seasonal average across the whole plotted window
  full_clim <- ts_combined %>%
    distinct(date) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(doy_climatology(data, date)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # build Monthly Trend plot
  p <- ggplot(ts_combined, aes(date, value, color = series, group = series, text = hover)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = fc_uncertainty, aes(date, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
                                           fill = "Empirical error range"),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_line(data = full_clim, aes(date, clim_mean, linetype = "Seasonal average"),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = bloom_threshold, linetype = "Bloom threshold"), color = "red") +
    scale_color_manual(values = setNames(c("black", branch_color), c("Observed", branch_label)), name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Empirical error range" = branch_color), name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Bloom threshold" = "dashed", "Seasonal average" = "dashed"), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Chlorophyll (ug/L)") +
    clean_theme

  p_caption <- paste0("<p class='section-caption'>Chl-a trends over the last 30 days + ",
                      "7-day forecast with the empirical error range (this site's own ",
                      "historical forecast error for that lead time) shown relative to the ",
                      "1-day-lead forecast. Hover over points for details.</p>")


  blank_line <- "<p>&nbsp;</p>"

  main_content <- if (branch == "Bloom") {
    onset <- find_bloom_onset_info(data, ref_date, bloom_threshold)
    peak_idx <- which.max(fc$chlorophyll_forecast)
    peak_value <- fc$chlorophyll_forecast[peak_idx]
    peak_date <- fc$date[peak_idx]
    above <- fc$chlorophyll_forecast > bloom_threshold
    duration_text <- if (all(above)) {
      paste0("still above threshold at the end of the 7-day forecast (", format(max(fc$date), "%b %d"), ")")
    } else {
      paste0("expected to drop back below threshold around <strong>", format(fc$date[which(!above)[1] - 1], "%b %d"), "</strong>")
    }
    onset_text <- if (!is.na(onset$days_since_onset)) paste0(" (day ", onset$days_since_onset, " of this bloom)") else ""
    severity <- bloom_severity(today_val)
    paste0("<p><strong>", buoy_name, "</strong> is currently in a <strong>", severity, "</strong> bloom", onset_text, "</p>",
          "<p>Forecasted to peak at <strong>", sprintf("%.1f", peak_value), " ug/L</strong> on <strong>",
          format(peak_date, "%b %d"), "</strong>, ", duration_text, "</p>")
  } else {

    above_future <- fc$chlorophyll_forecast > bloom_threshold
    crossing_text <- if (any(above_future)) {
      cross_date <- fc$date[which(above_future)[1]]
      paste0("<p>Expected to cross the bloom threshold around <strong>", format(cross_date, "%b %d"), "</strong></p>")
    } else {
      ""
    }
    paste0("<p><strong>", buoy_name, "</strong> is not currently in a bloom (",
          sprintf("%.1f", today_val), " ug/L, below the ", bloom_threshold, " ug/L threshold)</p>",
          crossing_text)
  }

  status_html <- paste0(
    "<div class='bloom-status'>",
    data_status_html, gap_warning_html, blank_line,
    main_content, blank_line,
    "<p class='csv-link'><a href='", csv_filename, "'>Click here to download raw forecasts</a></p>",
    "<p class='model-note'>Predictions use recursive Random Forest models for water conditions ",
    "and chl-a. See <a href='documentation.html'>Documentation</a> for more details.</p>",
    "</div>"
  )

  # recompute 1m water temp forecast for the outlook's secondary axis
  temp_train <- data[data$date <= ref_date, ]
  temp_model <- train_covariate_model(temp_train, "temp_1m")
  temp_seed <- lookup_with_fallback(data, "temp_1m", ref_date)
  temp1_fc <- if (!is.null(temp_model) && !is.na(temp_seed)) {
    forecast_one_covariate(temp_model, ref_date, temp_seed, nrow(fc)) %>%
      rename(temp_1m_forecast = value)
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  # build 7-Day Outlook data
  week_df <- fc %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(doy_climatology(data, date)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    left_join(fc_uncertainty %>% select(date, err_ymin = ymin, err_ymax = ymax), by = "date") %>%
    mutate(deviation = chlorophyll_forecast - clim_mean,
          day_label = paste0(format(date, "%a"), "\n", format(date, "%b %d")),
          day_label = factor(day_label, levels = day_label),
          hover = paste0(format(date, "%a, %b %d"), "<br>Forecast: ", round(chlorophyll_forecast, 1),
                        " ug/L<br>", sprintf("%+.1f", deviation), " ug/L vs seasonal normal",
                        "<br>Typical range: ", round(clim_low, 1), "-", round(clim_high, 1), " ug/L",
                        ifelse(!is.na(err_ymin),
                               paste0("<br>Empirical error range: ", round(err_ymin, 1), "-",
                                     round(err_ymax, 1), " ug/L"), "")))
  if (!is.null(temp1_fc)) {
    week_df <- week_df %>% left_join(temp1_fc, by = "date")
  } else {
    week_df$temp_1m_forecast <- NA_real_
  }

  # build 7-Day Outlook plot
  p2 <- ggplot(week_df, aes(day_label)) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = as.numeric(day_label) - 0.4, xmax = as.numeric(day_label) + 0.4,
                 ymin = clim_low, ymax = clim_high, fill = "Typical range")) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = as.numeric(day_label) - 0.4, xend = as.numeric(day_label) + 0.4,
                     y = clim_mean, yend = clim_mean, linetype = "Seasonal average"), color = "grey40") +
    geom_point(aes(y = chlorophyll_forecast, color = branch_label, text = hover), size = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Typical range" = "grey85"), name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Seasonal average" = "dashed"), name = NULL) +
    scale_color_manual(values = setNames(branch_color, branch_label), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Chlorophyll (ug/L)") +
    clean_theme +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

  # clean up plotly legend labels and hover/dedup traces
  no_hover <- c("Typical range", "Seasonal average", "Empirical error range")
  no_legend <- character(0)
  polish_traces <- function(p_ly) {
    seen <- character(0)
    p_ly$x$data <- lapply(p_ly$x$data, function(tr) {
      if (!is.null(tr$name)) tr$name <- sub("^\\((.*?),.*\\)$", "\\1", tr$name)
      if (!is.null(tr$name) && tr$name %in% no_hover) tr$hoverinfo <- "skip"
      if (!is.null(tr$name) && tr$name %in% no_legend) tr$showlegend <- FALSE
      if (!is.null(tr$name)) {
        if (tr$name %in% seen) tr$showlegend <- FALSE else seen <<- c(seen, tr$name)
      }
      tr
    })
    p_ly
  }

  # convert a ggplot to a responsive plotly widget
  make_responsive <- function(gp, height = NULL) {
    plotly::ggplotly(gp, tooltip = "text", height = height) %>%
      polish_traces() %>%
      plotly::layout(autosize = TRUE, font = list(family = "Barlow Condensed, sans-serif"),
                     legend = list(font = list(size = 18))) %>%
      plotly::config(responsive = TRUE)
  }

  p2_widget <- make_responsive(p2, height = 560)

  # add empirical error range as native plotly error bars
  if (any(!is.na(week_df$err_ymin))) {
    p2_widget <- p2_widget %>%
      plotly::add_trace(
        data = week_df, x = ~as.numeric(day_label), y = ~chlorophyll_forecast,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers", marker = list(color = branch_color, opacity = 0.6, size = 9),
        error_y = list(type = "data", symmetric = FALSE,
                       array = week_df$err_ymax - week_df$chlorophyll_forecast,
                       arrayminus = week_df$chlorophyll_forecast - week_df$err_ymin,
                       color = branch_color, thickness = 2, width = 6),
        name = "Empirical error range", hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = TRUE
      )
  }

  # add 1m water temp as a second line on a right-hand axis
  if (!is.null(temp1_fc) && any(!is.na(week_df$temp_1m_forecast))) {
    p2_widget <- p2_widget %>%
      plotly::add_trace(
        data = week_df, x = ~as.numeric(day_label), y = ~temp_1m_forecast,
        type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers", yaxis = "y2",
        name = "Water temp forecast (1m)",
        line = list(color = "#D55E00", dash = "dot"),
        marker = list(color = "#D55E00", size = 6),
        text = ~paste0(format(date, "%a, %b %d"), "<br>1m water temp: ", round(temp_1m_forecast, 1), " C"),
        hoverinfo = "text"
      ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        yaxis = list(title = list(font = list(size = 17))),
        yaxis2 = list(overlaying = "y", side = "right", showgrid = FALSE,
                      title = list(text = "1m water temp (C)", font = list(size = 17))),
        margin = list(r = 80, b = 130),
        # legend below the plot, clear of the right-hand axis
        legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = -0.22, font = list(size = 16))
      )
  }

  # set Monthly Trend legend order
  p_widget <- make_responsive(p)
  legend_rank <- setNames(1:5, c("Observed", branch_label, "Empirical error range",
                                 "Seasonal average", "Bloom threshold"))
  p_widget$x$data <- lapply(p_widget$x$data, function(tr) {
    if (!is.null(tr$name) && tr$name %in% names(legend_rank)) {
      tr$legendrank <- legend_rank[[tr$name]]
    }
    tr
  })

  # build Annual Trend data, same as Monthly Trend but from Jan 1
  year_start <- as.Date(paste0(format(ref_date, "%Y"), "-01-01"))
  annual_recent <- data %>% filter(date >= year_start, date <= ref_date) %>% select(date, chlorophyll)
  annual_ts_combined <- bind_rows(
    annual_recent %>% rename(value = chlorophyll) %>% mutate(series = "Observed"),
    fc_plot %>% rename(value = chlorophyll_forecast) %>% mutate(series = branch_label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(hover = paste0(format(date, "%b %d, %Y"), "<br>", series, ": ", round(value, 2), " ug/L")) %>%
    left_join(fc_clim %>% select(date, clim_low, clim_high), by = "date") %>%
    left_join(fc_uncertainty %>% select(date, ymin, ymax), by = "date") %>%
    mutate(hover = ifelse(series == branch_label & !is.na(clim_low),
                          paste0(hover, "<br>Typical range: ", round(clim_low, 1), "-", round(clim_high, 1), " ug/L"),
                          hover),
          hover = ifelse(series == branch_label & !is.na(ymin),
                          paste0(hover, "<br>80% interval: ", round(ymin, 1), "-", round(ymax, 1), " ug/L"),
                          hover)) %>%
    select(-clim_low, -clim_high, -ymin, -ymax)

  annual_full_clim <- annual_ts_combined %>%
    distinct(date) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(doy_climatology(data, date)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # build Annual Trend plot
  p_annual <- ggplot(annual_ts_combined, aes(date, value, color = series, group = series, text = hover)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = fc_uncertainty, aes(date, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
                                           fill = "Empirical error range"),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_line(data = annual_full_clim, aes(date, clim_mean, linetype = "Seasonal average"),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = bloom_threshold, linetype = "Bloom threshold"), color = "red") +
    scale_color_manual(values = setNames(c("black", branch_color), c("Observed", branch_label)), name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Empirical error range" = branch_color), name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Bloom threshold" = "dashed", "Seasonal average" = "dashed"), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Chlorophyll (ug/L)") +
    clean_theme

  p_annual_caption <- paste0("<p class='section-caption'>Chl-a trends year-to-date (",
                             format(year_start, "%b %d"), " to present) + 7-day forecast with ",
                             "the empirical error range (this site's own historical forecast ",
                             "error for that lead time) shown relative to the 1-day-lead ",
                             "forecast. Hover over points for details.</p>")

  p_annual_widget <- make_responsive(p_annual)
  p_annual_widget$x$data <- lapply(p_annual_widget$x$data, function(tr) {
    if (!is.null(tr$name) && tr$name %in% names(legend_rank)) {
      tr$legendrank <- legend_rank[[tr$name]]
    }
    tr
  })

  # build Windy currents map
  buoy_lat <- cfg$buoys[[buoy_id]]$lat
  buoy_lon <- cfg$buoys[[buoy_id]]$lon
  windy_url <- paste0(
    "https://embed.windy.com/embed2.html?lat=", buoy_lat, "&lon=", buoy_lon,
    "&detailLat=", buoy_lat, "&detailLon=", buoy_lon,
    "&width=650&height=500&zoom=9&level=surface&overlay=currents&product=ecmwf",
    "&menu=&message=true&marker=true&calendar=now&pressure=&type=map",
    "&location=coordinates&metricWind=default&metricTemp=default"
  )
  # build iframe at page-load time
  map_id <- paste0("windy-map-", buoy_id)
  buoy_map <- htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::tags$div(id = map_id, style = "width:100%;height:500px;"),
    htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(paste0(
      "document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {",
      "var f = document.createElement('iframe');",
      "f.src = '", windy_url, "';",
      "f.width = '100%'; f.height = '500'; f.style.border = '0'; f.frameBorder = '0';",
      "document.getElementById('", map_id, "').appendChild(f);",
      "});"
    )))
  )
  coords_text <- sprintf("%.4f, %.4f", buoy_lat, buoy_lon)

  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::HTML(paste0("<h2 class='buoy-heading'>Site: ", buoy_name, "</h2>")),
    htmltools::HTML(status_html),
    htmltools::HTML("<p class='buoy-map-title'>Buoy Location</p>"),
    htmltools::HTML("<p class='section-caption'>Local currents (toggle for more layers)</p>"),
    htmltools::div(class = "buoy-map", buoy_map),
    htmltools::HTML(paste0("<p class='buoy-coords'>", coords_text, "</p>")),
    htmltools::HTML("<p class='buoy-map-title'>7-Day Outlook</p>"),
    htmltools::HTML("<p class='section-caption'>Each forecasted day compared to what's typical for this time of year. Hover over points for details.</p>"),
    p2_widget,
    htmltools::HTML("<p class='buoy-map-title'>Monthly Trend</p>"),
    htmltools::HTML(p_caption),
    p_widget,
    htmltools::HTML("<p class='buoy-map-title'>Annual Trend</p>"),
    htmltools::HTML(p_annual_caption),
    p_annual_widget
  )
})

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::HTML(paste0("<p class='today-line'>Today, ", format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y"), "</p>")),
  buoy_sections
)
```
